ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, what is the decomposer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The title in the image is “Food Chains in Tundra”. Each row of the food chain starts with the sun, passes through plants or animals, and on the far right all end with mushroom-shaped organisms. Then reason: In ecology, decomposers break down dead organic matter, and common decomposers include fungi. The mushrooms on the far right in the image represent fungi, so the decomposers in the image are fungi.
